liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Mississippi Half-Step Uptown Toodeloo** (1 review): Jerry's voice is described as honey on a silver spoon on this track [12]
- **Franklin's Tower** (1 review): Bobby's guitar features a psychedelic sliding drone fest on this song [12]
- **Looks Like Rain** (1 review): The ballads, including this track, are highlighted as excellent performances [16]
- **Jam** (1 review): The second set opened with a Jam because Weir was not on stage [11]
- **Jack-A-Roe** (1 review): This opening track of the second set is the reviewer's favorite version [17]
- **Shakedown Street** (1 review): The performance is described as super chunky and funky [17]
- **If I Had The World To Give** (1 review): This rare and gorgeous performance is a standout for the reviewer [16]

## The recordings

- **gd1978-11-20.sbd.fix.miller.95660.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 144 min; rated 3.47/5 by 17 [1]. Said about its sound: Quality suffers from multiple sources, but the mix is considered a fine representation; The reviewer enjoys the moments where soundboard and audience tapes bleed into each other; Too many sources prevent good sound, though the performance itself is well played [8][10][18]
- **gd1978-11-20.sbd.miller.95244.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 151 min; rated 2.6/5 by 5 [2]
- **gd1978-11-20.s1.s2p.aud.seaweed.117661.flac1644**: audience recording; 16 songs; 99 min [3]. Said about its sound: The audio has some hiss and is somewhat degraded in quality [3]
- **gd1978-11-20.mtx-set2.chappell.sb16a.32489.sbeok.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 10 songs; 65 min; rated 4.67/5 by 3 [4]

## Around the show

- Weir was backstage getting sick, missing the start of the second set [11]
- The show is considered as good as any played by the band in the 1970s [13]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1978-11-20.sbd.fix.miller.95660.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Source 1: SBD -> ? -> Cassette -> Sound Devices 744T -> Samplitude DSource 2: SBD -> Master Cassette -> Dat -> CD DSource 3: Nakamichi 300 -> Reels? -> Dat ->… [1]. Also: Source 2 may contain an extra cassette generation in the recording; A tape flip occurs within the recording of Looks Like Rain [1]
- **gd1978-11-20.sbd.miller.95244.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Source 1: SBD -> ? -> Cassette -> CD DSource 2: SBD -> Master Cassette -> Dat -> CD DSource 3: Nakamichi 300 -> Reels? -> Dat -> CD DSource 4: SBD -> Master… [2]. Also: Original cassette from the 80s is degrading, prompting a request for digital download; Sources 1 and 3 are derived from the file with ID 21727 [2][7]
- **gd1978-11-20.s1.s2p.aud.seaweed.117661.flac1644**: taped by seaweed1010; transferred by AndrewF; source: Source: Unknown AUD (marked 4th gen) kindly provided by Seaweed1010. [3]. Also: Seaweed provided the unknown audience tape for Set One and start of Set Two [3]
- **gd1978-11-20.mtx-set2.chappell.sb16a.32489.sbeok.flac16**: taped by See info file; transferred by Chris Chappell; source: See info file [4]. Also: The LlaMA pulled the SBDs, preventing access to the updated multiple source [4]
